subject: Request: Trial surge sponsorship for FlexiCode RFP
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@flexicode.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@flexicode.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: Trial surge sponsorship for FlexiCode RFP

Connor,

Quick note from procurement — FlexiCode has a bake-off for an internal search/retrieval RFP that kicks off Monday. Redwood is in the running but the internal evaluation team is asking for an expanded test allocation to complete head-to-head throughput and latency comparisons.

Specifically: can Redwood provide a one-time trial surge (short-term token uplift) and a 45-day trial extension on the hosted trial so our engineers can run the full 10M token scenario? Our procurement timeline is tight; we need confirmation by end of day Monday to include in the committee packet.

We'd be grateful — FlexiCode is leaning toward a partner that supports a realistic evaluation. Happy to sign a simple sponsorship letter if that helps.

Best,
Alice Chen
Sourcing Manager, FlexiCode
Attachments: rfp-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Request: Trial surge sponsorship for FlexiCode RFP

Looping finance and sales ops for quick triage — external request (below) from FlexiCode for a one-time trial surge + 45-day extension. They need OK by EOD Monday.

Proposed offer (draft):
- One-time token uplift: 5,000,000 evaluation tokens (hosted)
- Trial window extended by 45 days from approval
- Conditional: standard evaluation SLA, no production ingestion; sponsorship expires if customer doesn't engage commercial rep within 60 days
- In exchange: FlexiCode signs a sponsorship letter acknowledging the trial scope and agrees to a pilot commitment conversation for Dedicated within 30 days

I've attached a quick draft proposal (redwood_trial_proposal_v1.pdf) and the high-level RFP. Ben — I know we discussed an alternate smaller uplift + concierge support. If finance can't swallow full uplift, what's the minimum impactful amount?

Neha — can you run a back-of-envelope cost for 5M tokens (expected unit costs) and a fallback smaller option (1.5M tokens + 40 support hours)? Need an approval path (sales credit, promo bucket, or deal-specific).

If we can get a thumbs-up by tomorrow morning I'll reply to Alice with an official terms snippet they can sign.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Exec — Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_trial_proposal_v1.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 13:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Trial surge sponsorship for FlexiCode RFP

Connor — quick numbers attached.

Back-of-envelope cost for 5,000,000 eval tokens: ~$1,750 (mix of cached + new tokens, hosted pricing tiers). If we allocate from the centralized promo pool we can grant up to 7M tokens this quarter but it will hit the promo budget and needs a rationale (competitive displacement).

Alternative recommendation (lower operational risk):
- Offer 1,500,000 tokens + 40 hours of concierge performance tuning (engineer time).
- Offer a 30-day extension instead of 45 days to reduce bucket exposure.
- Require a simple sponsorship letter and a brief pilot commitment (non-binding) that they will discuss Dedicated capacity/commit within 90 days if results meet perf criteria.

I've uploaded the spreadsheet (cost_model_flexicode.xlsx) and linked the HubSpot deal. If leadership wants to be aggressive (win vs vendor X), we should push for the full 5M and include a clause that credits are only for evaluation (no production).

Neha
Director, Sales Finance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: cost_model_flexicode.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Trial surge sponsorship for FlexiCode RFP

Agree with Neha's conservative path but offer an escalation option. If leadership signs off we should provide the full 5M to show clear product differentiation. If not, propose the 1.5M + concierge support.

Also recommend we include 3 hours of onboarding with a solution architect and one performance healthcheck during the evaluation window — that usually tips technical reviewers. I'll draft a short MOP to include in the sponsorship letter.

Draft attachments: mop_sample.docx

Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@flexicode.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Trial surge sponsorship for FlexiCode RFP

Alice — thanks for the patience. We reviewed internally and can support a targeted evaluation allocation with the following mutually agreed terms: 

1) Trial allocation: 1,500,000 evaluation tokens (hosted) plus 40 hours of concierge performance support (solution architect, up to 1 healthcheck).
2) Trial extension: +30 days to their existing hosted trial period; extension will begin upon voucher activation.
3) Conditionality: Credits are evaluation-only (no production traffic). Voucher will expire 60 days after issue if not activated.
4) Commercial cadence: FlexiCode agrees to a pilot conversation with our Strategic Solutions team within 90 days; this is non-binding for procurement but helps prioritize capacity.
5) Legal: No special IP or data terms beyond our standard trial policy; we can sign a one-page sponsorship letter confirming the above.

If that looks acceptable I will issue a voucher code and a short sponsorship letter for signature. If you need the larger 5M uplift, we can escalate to leadership for an exception (will require business justification).

Next steps: Please confirm acceptance and we'll send the voucher and onboarding link.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Exec — Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference
Attachments: flexicode_credit_voucher.txt (voucher placeholder), sponsorship_letter_draft.pdf (stub)
